        response.raise_for_status()  # Raises stored HTTPError for bad responses
        return response.text  # Returns the content of the response
    except requests.exceptions.HTTPError as http_err:

If any other type of error occurs, it is caught by the general `RequestException`.

The `data` variable will contain the content of the response if the request was successful, or an error message if it wasn't.
